Joins 2026 code-violation counts per tract to CDC adult high-blood-pressure prevalence and total population, computes violations per 1,000 residents, and returns the paired-tract correlation and count ordered by the violation rate.
sql:
WITH violations AS (
  SELECT geoid,
         CAST(n AS DOUBLE) AS code_violations
  FROM fw_pg.tract_counts
  WHERE run_id = 'r_20261027_bac059'
    AND source = 'm1_city'
    AND grp = 'all'
),
health AS (
  SELECT tractfips AS geoid,
         CAST(totalpopulation AS DOUBLE) AS totalpopulation,
         CAST(bphigh_crudeprev AS DOUBLE) AS high_blood_pressure_prevalence
  FROM session.fw_bac059_m2_cdc
),
paired AS (
  SELECT t.name,
         t.geoid,
         COALESCE(v.code_violations, 0) AS code_violations,
         h.totalpopulation,
         (COALESCE(v.code_violations, 0) / h.totalpopulation) * 1000.0 AS code_violations_per_1000_residents,
         h.high_blood_pressure_prevalence
  FROM fw_pg.tracts t
  LEFT JOIN violations v ON t.geoid = v.geoid
  JOIN health h ON t.geoid = h.geoid
  WHERE h.totalpopulation IS NOT NULL
    AND h.totalpopulation > 0
    AND h.high_blood_pressure_prevalence IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT name,
       code_violations_per_1000_residents,
       code_violations,
       totalpopulation,
       high_blood_pressure_prevalence,
       CORR(code_violations_per_1000_residents, high_blood_pressure_prevalence) OVER () AS violations_per_1000_residents_vs_high_blood_pressure_correlation,
       COUNT(*) OVER () AS paired_tracts,
       geoid
FROM paired
ORDER BY code_violations_per_1000_residents DESC NULLS LAST, name ASC
LIMIT 200

  SELECT geoid,
         CAST(n AS DOUBLE) AS code_violations
  FROM fw_pg.tract_counts

    AND source = 'm1_city'

health AS (
  SELECT tractfips AS geoid,
         CAST(totalpopulation AS DOUBLE) AS totalpopulation,
         CAST(bphigh_crudeprev AS DOUBLE) AS high_blood_pressure_prevalence
  FROM session.fw_bac059_m2_cdc
),
paired AS (
  SELECT t.name,
         t.geoid,
         COALESCE(v.code_violations, 0) AS code_violations,
         h.totalpopulation,
         (COALESCE(v.code_violations, 0) / h.totalpopulation) * 1000.0 AS code_violations_per_1000_residents,
         h.high_blood_pressure_prevalence

  JOIN health h ON t.geoid = h.geoid
  WHERE h.totalpopulation IS NOT NULL
    AND h.totalpopulation > 0
